title: Discord Task Channels
purpose: Gives each task its own Discord channel.
description: Creates one private Discord channel for each task. Commands such as new, done, reopen and list work in a commands channel. Finished tasks move to a Done group and old ones are tidied up each day. It has no Discord login of its own. It starts in test mode, where it creates nothing.
